description: List invoices for the authenticated FreshBooks account — what clients owe, with each invoice's due date and status. Supports pagination and raw FreshBooks filter params. Returns items plus page/pages/total; view "brief" returns one line per invoice instead.

search.description: Raw FreshBooks filter params passed through verbatim, e.g. {"search[customerid]": 123} or {"include[]": "lines"}. Field names are not validated.

view.description: "full" (default) returns FreshBooks' invoices plus page/pages/total; "brief" returns one line per invoice: Invoice <number>, <client>, <amount> — <due date or "no date"> — <status>, inside the untrusted-data envelope as data (client names are third-party text), with "-- " note lines for an empty page ("-- none") or a partial one ("-- N of M shown", "-- more").

name: freshbooks_list_invoices
